snippet.title: Master Lemon: The Quest for Iceland - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
On November 4, join Lemon on his quest to master languages and save a mysterious island from a memory-devouring plague in Master Lemon: The Quest for Iceland!

The game will be available on Steam, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S.

PLAY THE DEMO NOW!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3070390/Master_Lemon_The_Quest_for_Iceland/
